notes.title: Version 1.0.8: Click to Move Added + Minor bug fix!
notes.notes:
Hello moles,

Thanks as always for your support of Gemporium!! We have a small update today including one frequently-requested feature.

[h3]Click to Move[/h3]
You can now use the mouse to move, allowing for mouse-only gameplay if you want! (Right-click also now works as an interact button; if you see any places where the button prompt still says 'E,' just use right-click and it should still work.)

You can find this option in the accessibility settings.

[h3]Other[/h3]
We've fixed a bug where if you paused and unpaused during a mining minigame, you'd be able to move Moel while still mining.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

That's all; we can't promise any major updates going forward due to our development scope, but this was one feature we really wanted to get in. We hope it helps more players enjoy the mines :)

- Merge Conflict Studio

notes.title: 19,000 UNITS WOW!!!!!!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Moles, we've reached another incredible milestone in just over a week![/p][p][/p][h1]Thank you for 19k copies sold!!![/h1][p][/p][p]We have been overjoyed and frankly blown away at the positive reception for our little game, so from the bottom of our hearts we want to thank you. It's only been a week since launch and we've surpassed all of our goals for this game by a long shot! It's very surreal to have this many people like what we made :)[/p][p][/p][p]We've pushed a few hotfixes and a patch to address some user feedback, but we know there are some greater questions being asked by the fans:[/p][p][/p][h2]Controller support?[/h2][p]We would love to add controller support, and know it is one of the most requested features! While we are still unsure of how long we want to continue working on Gemporium, this is something we would like to work on in the coming months.[/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Deck Verification?[/h2][p]This is also highly requested, and we would love to get Gemporium steam deck verified! We don't have a timeline as of now but stay tuned for more information.[/p][p][/p][h2]Localization?[/h2][p]Unfortunately due to our size and scope of the project, we didn't set out to localize the game and most likely won't be adding it in the future. [/p][p][/p][h2]More Content?[/h2][p]To be honest, we don't know! It's great to see so many people become invested in the game but don't want to make any promises that may or may not happen. If there are any plans for additional content or updates we will be sure to update the community![/p][p][/p][h2]What's Next?[/h2][p][b]We're taking a vacation![/b] A much needed rest is in order for us to recharge and relax after shipping a game. We'll be back in 2 weeks but expect for us to be a bit silent while we get back into the swing of things. If you reeeeaally want a teaser though.....[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3657320/Project_Wish/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]<3[/p][p]Merge Conflict Studio[/p]

The loan shark will now only visit on Saturdays as apposed to Saturdays and Wednesdays.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]High Contrast Text[/p][list][*][p]New accessibility option is available for those who have a hard time reading certain text in the game[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Bug fixes / balance changes[/h2][list][*][p]The loan shark now mentions the fact that Grandmole left you 1 million glimmer to pay off[/p][/*][*][p]$ signs across the game were replaced with the symbol for Glimmer[/p][/*][*][p]Reworded some of the upgrades to be clearer and more concise[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation screen when starting a new game to avoid confusion with overriding saves[/p][/*][*][p]Added plaques to the artifact collections that hint toward their rewards + changes to display said reward once the collection is unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the trash icon in the gem bag to an actual trash can[/p][/*][*][p]The tutorial for “Uncool Customers” now plays if the first customer of the shop is an uncool customer[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly tweaked artifact generation to make it more consistent[/p][/*][*][p]Rewrote the loan repayment info screen to be more concise and descriptive[/p][/*][*][p]The letter description for early loan repayment will now automatically open the first time you access the early repayment table[/p][/*][*][p]*your (dialogue typo fixed)[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced \[x] icon with a trash can in the gem bag for more clarity[/p][/*][*][p]Added SFX to gem bag trash can for player feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Moved some rocks in the mines that could softlock the player[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where mouse input would skip incomplete lines of dialogue[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where tooltips would sometimes get stuck on the cursor when starting a new game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that caused chatter’s messages to not appear in the shop when using Twitch Integration[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the resolution menu not accurately displaying all possible resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the early bird bonus not being accurately applied to the next loan payment & the total debt remaining[/p][/*][*][p]Music notes.title: Thank you + Updates/Fixes coming soon!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello Moles,[/h3][p][/p][p]Firstly, all of us here at Merge Conflict Studio want to say THANK YOU so much for your overwhelming support of Gemporium! It's been better than we ever imagined and means the world to us. YOU'RE THE BEST! <3[/p][p][/p][p]Secondly, we've greatly appreciated your feedback on the game and are looking into ways to address some of the most common points that have been brought up. Some of these include:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Loan Shark visits being overwhelming[/b][/p][p]We want to find a way to help players who feel overwhelmed by the Loan Shark's visits feel more equipped to keep up with them while not sacrificing the intended structure and experience of the game. 
If you'd like a quick tip for this just for now: try completing an Artifact collection if you haven't![/p][/*][*][p][b]Unclear details of Early Repayment Plan[/b][/p][p]We've noticed that some players have been a bit confused by how the Early Repayment Plan works, especially with regards to why they still have to make payments on Loan Shark days after using it. 

[b][i]The TL;DR on it[/i][/b] is that the Loan Shark will always ask for some minimum payment on scheduled days, but you can reduce this amount significantly with the Early Repayment Plan. Past this minimum, any payments you make will only reduce your total debt rather than your next payment.

We're hoping to increase clarity on this! There is a UI element that's meant to let you know when you've hit the minimum, but we've noticed some bugs with this and are hoping to fix this up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lack of Controller Support[/b][/p][p]This one will likely take longer to address because it's a fairly involved endeavor, but we've absolutely heard everyone asking for it and would like to add it at some point in the future.[/p][/*][*][p][b]General Bugs[/b][/p][p]We appreciate your bug reports and have a list of some we want to prioritize fixing first, including one with one of the Achievements.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]There's more stuff on our list that we'd like to address, but we wanted to call these out specifically.[/p][p][/p][p]We really appreciate your patience as we work on all this! We are a small team of five and worked within a short development timeline to finish this game, but want to do our best to provide everyone with the best version of Gemporium possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks and as always, good luck in the Mines![/p][p][/p][p]The Merge Conflict Team[/p]

notes.title: We are Updating the Art Style for Gemporium
notes.notes:
[h1]Our current art sucks.[/h1]

It's hard to come to terms with reality, but at Merge Conflict Studio we are committed to the players and boy have they spoken. 

The demo has allowed our small studio to get waves and waves of feedback from players, so if you have played and given us your honest thoughts thank you! We have heard your complaints and have tried to ignore it for too long. No one likes with cute and cozy art styles anymore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489305/c377ce09052c61a41118e3c4ce2f114434296827.png[/img]

In order to stay relevant in this horrible market for games and make sure we can continue to sustain the studio doing what we love, we have made the difficult decision to pivot and fired our artist. Now, we are full sending the new vision for a [b]Realistic, High Fidelity, Raytraced Gemporium[/b].

[h1]Sneak a peek at the new art:[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489305/315791ca04e3d7c61a400c6932735b48e6454871.png[/img]

We are so excited to share this update with you and hope that the AAA approach to graphics will help us find a larger player base. As of now we have only [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2836100/Gemporium_A_Cute_Mining_Sim/]updated the steam page[/url] to reflect the new style, but we hope to continue listening and internalizing the feedback from this lovely community.

To make SURE that the Gamers know we are making a Real Product, Gemporium install size will also grow by 200gb.

notes.title: Gemporium Demo Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello gem enthusiasts!

Once again, thanks so much for trying out the Gemporium demo! As always, if you want to stay up to date with Gemporium and the happenings of Merge Conflict and/or provide feedback, you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/8N24D6G6zN]Discord[/url]!

We've got one main new feature today and some other fixes! Let's get into it.

[h1]Version 1.2 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Additions and Misc. Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a new tutorial system! When you start a new save, you will now be asked if you want to do the tutorial. The new tutorial takes place on “Day 0” with no timer running to give you more breathing room to get accustomed to everything in the game.
[*]Added a tutorial popup that lets you know you can return to the mines multiple times a day for new gems.
[*]Added animations to tutorial popups opening and closing.
[*]Added an arrow that bounces over areas you’re being prompted to use in the tutorial to make sure you don’t miss ‘em.
[*]Touched up performance! There should now be less occasional stutters, which we observed was happening for some players.
[*]Slightly increased the buffer time between when buttons linking to external pages on the “Thanks for playing” screen are revealed and when they can be clicked.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where if you just finished refining a gem, you could place another already-refined gem on the table and the gem would get huge and cover the whole screen. Glad we stomped that one :)
[*]Fixed an issue where if you didn’t close a tutorial popup and reentered the area that activated it, you could get a duplicate of that popup.
[*]Fixed an issue where the TV would reactivate automatically every time you reentered the main Hub.
[*]Did some UI cleanup for ultrawide monitors in some scenes.
[/list]

notes.title: Gemporium Demo Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello gem enthusiasts!

First we would like to thank each and every one of you for trying out the Gemporium Demo, we truly appreciate it! <3 We have been listening to all of the comments & feedback, and are eager to continue working on the game. That being said if you haven't already, join the [url=https://discord.gg/SWStWN9Xyw]Discord[/url] to stay up to date with Gemporium, give us more feedback on the demo and see what else we have cooking at Merge Conflict! Today we have a small update to address some feedback after our first week: 

[h1]Version 1.1 Patch Notes[/h1]

[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where multiple mining spots would generate over each other, leading to a "phantom" spot that either looked interactable or stayed lit after it was used
[*]Fixed the weird collision issues with stone fragments in the refinement minigame
[*]Fixed a bug where leaving and entering the mines quickly would put a tiny gem on the floor
[*]Fixed a bug where dragging an already refined gem into the refinement spot would make it cover the entire screen
[*]Fixed a bug that allowed you to continue mining for gems while the game was paused
[*]Fixed a bug where sometimes the gem bag upgrade wasn't functioning properly
[*]Fixed a bug with audio settings not loading correctly
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Day length as well as shop length has been extended
[*]Day 1 now has a special longer length to help with onboarding

[h2]Casual Mode[/h2]
There is now a new setting for Casual mode, which disables the in game timer and opens the shop at the start of every day. This allows you to freely mine, refine and sell whenever you would like! Finishing a shop day (whether by leaving the shop, selling all of your gems or running out of customers) will progress you to night time. The demo is not currently balanced around Casual mode, so we do recommend new players to leave it disabled (but I'm not your mom do what you want).
